movelist.name: Healing Wish
movelist.effect: The user immediately Faints, lowering its HP to 0. The user takes no Injuries from HP Markers when using Healing Wish.  The target is immediately cured of up to 3 injuries, healed to their Maximum Hit Points, and has the Frequency of all Moves restored. Healing Wish may target a Pokémon in a Poké Ball. Healing Wish does not restore the Frequency of Healing Wish or Lunar Dance. Injuries healed through Healing Wish count toward the total number of Injuries that can be healed each day, and this healing is limited by the same.

movelist.name: Gravity
movelist.effect: For 5 rounds, the area is considered Warped. While Warped, Moves that involve the user being airborne may not be used. Pokémon cannot use Sky or Levitate Capabilities to end their turn at an altitude higher than 1 meter. Flying-Types and Pokémon with the Ability Levitate no longer resist Ground-Type Moves, and Pokémon cannot use Sky or Levitate Capabilities for immunity to Moves with the Groundsource keyword. All Accuracy Rolls receive a +2 Bonus.

movelist.name: Zen Headbutt
movelist.effect: Zen Headbutt Flinches the target on 15+.

movelist.name: Rest
movelist.effect: The user is set to their full Hit Point value. The user is cured of any Status ailments. Then, the user falls Asleep. The user cannot make Sleep Checks at the beginning of their turn. They are cured of the Sleep at the end of their turn in 2 rounds.

movelist.name: Refresh
movelist.effect: The user is cured of all Poison, Burns, and Paralysis.

abilities.name: Serene Grace
abilities.effect: The user’s Effect Range is increased by +2.

abilities.name: Wishmaster
abilities.effect: Connection – Wish. Whenever the user uses Wish, the user may pick one of the following effects: the target is healed instantly instead of the following round; or the target gains +2 CS to the Stat of their choice upon being healed; or the target is cured of any Status Affliction.

abilities.name: Wonder Skin
abilities.effect: The user gains +6 Evasion against Status Moves. Defensive.
